# B'more Tech Hackathon

> A free evening hackathon in Baltimore on Thursday, December 10, 2026, 6 to 8 p.m. Eastern, at Digital Harbor Tech Lab, 1045 Light St, Baltimore, MD 21230. Bring a real problem from your business, build a fix with AI, and demo it to the room. Sponsored by Knucklepuck.

## Event

- Date and time: Thursday, December 10, 2026, 6 to 8 p.m. Eastern. Doors open at 6 p.m.
- Venue: Digital Harbor Tech Lab, 1045 Light St, Baltimore, MD 21230
- Cost: Free to attend. Space is limited and every RSVP is reviewed, so register early.
- Registration: [Register on Luma](https://luma.com/yfd1ajxu)
- Who should come: solo founders, teams, early-stage companies, and late-stage companies. Anyone is welcome, and you don't need to write code. If you can describe what you need, AI can build it with you.

## Schedule

- 6 p.m.: Doors open and a quick kickoff
- 6:15 p.m.: Build, solo or with your team
- 7:30 p.m.: Demos, then prizes for the best builds: 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place

## What to bring

- A laptop
- A charger
- An AI tool you can log into. Set up your accounts before you arrive, because 75 minutes goes fast.

## FAQ

- Do I need to know how to code? No. If you can describe what you need, AI can build it with you. Anyone is welcome.
- Who should come? Solo founders, teams, and early-stage and late-stage companies. If something in your business eats a few hours every week, bring it.
- How much does it cost? Nothing. The hackathon is free to attend. Space is limited and every RSVP is reviewed, so register early on Luma.
- Can I come alone, or should I bring a team? Either works. Build solo or bring your team.
- What will I build? A fix for a real problem from your business. Building starts at 6:15 p.m. and demos start at 7:30 p.m.
- Are there prizes? Yes. After the demos, the best builds take 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place.

## Sponsor

- [Knucklepuck](https://knucklepuckmedia.com): a DC-based digital marketing agency specializing in organic search, paid media, and content strategy. Knucklepuck sponsors B'more Tech so Baltimore's founders and builders have a place to make things and meet each other.
